title: Rabindranath Tagore Beach
author: Amin
description: A popular city beach perfect for evening walks, sea views and relaxing by the waterfront.

title: Devbagh Beach
author: Mack
description: A serene and less crowded beach, ideal for water sports, dolphin spotting, and peaceful sunsets.

title: Kurumgad Island
author: Rubel
description: A scenic island accessible by boat, known for its temple, adventure activities, and beautiful coastal views.

title: Oyster Rock Lighthouse
author: Ashiq
description: A historic lighthouse on an island offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Arabian Sea.

title: Tilmati Beach
author: Ashiq
description: Famous for its unique black sand, this quiet beach is perfect for a peaceful and picturesque escape.

title: Sadashivgad Fort
author: Amin
description: A historic hilltop fort overlooking the Kali River, ideal for history lovers and scenic viewpoints.
